checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible components (receiver, barrel, grip) align linearly and match the silhouette of an AK-pattern rifle.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped; the buttstock is missing, making it impossible to judge the overall length or the barrel-to-total-length ratio.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object has a consistent matte black/dark gray appearance typical of parkerized metal and polymer.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central receiver block is visible, and the distinctive curved 'banana' magazine is clearly inserted into the mag well.
A long barrel extends from the receiver. While the very tip is near the edge, the barrel structure is present and correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Distinguishing features include magazine well and ejection port.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The magazine well is clearly defined by the inserted magazine. The ejection port area on the right side of the receiver is visible and structurally correct for this model.

artifact_observations.location: Front sight post and gas block area
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring in the fine details of the front sight assembly compared to the sharper receiver edges, potentially indicating minor generation smoothing or resolution limits.
